name: reduce the difference to the goal by choosing an operator
mechanism: compare the current state to the goal, pick the largest difference, choose an operator known to reduce that kind of difference, recursively make its preconditions true, apply it, and repeat

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'General Problem Solver' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Graph algorithms / Graph search: a seminal theorem-proving algorithm intended to work as a universal problem solver machine.

requires: a difference table from differences to operators (a human prior)
fails_when: the difference table is the whole intelligence
